name: @tekromancy/tekromancy
description: High-voltage procedural lightning and atmospheric visual FX engine for presentations and web applications

scripts.build: vite build && cp src/lightning/lightning.css dist/lightning.css && cp src/fire/fire.css dist/fire.css && cp src/smoke/smoke.css dist/smoke.css && cp src/plasma/plasma.css dist/plasma.css && cp src/water/water.css dist/water.css && cp src/ice/ice.css dist/ice.css && cp src/core/highlight.css dist/highlight.css && cat src/lightning/lightning.css src/fire/fire.css src/smoke/smoke.css src/plasma/plasma.css src/water/water.css src/ice/ice.css src/core/highlight.css > dist/tekromancy.css
scripts.test: node --check src/index.js && node --check src/lightning/index.js && node --check src/fire/index.js && node --check src/smoke/index.js && node --check src/plasma/index.js && node --check src/water/index.js && node --check src/ice/index.js && node --check src/core/index.js && node --check src/core/ElementHighlighter.js

author: Joshua Cox <joshua@tekromancy.com>
